a regulator-family-independent physical NLO leading-log response

body.forbid: no resolution dilation called a time Moller evolution; no asymptotic momentum detector algebra called spacetime-local AQFT; no leading-log response called a finite complete NLO probability; no all-order Eq. (19), beyond-tree positivity, gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
